name: Hyponoia
source:
Euell, a vampire bat, is known for his witticisms and penmanship. He is not known for his surgical prowess. His friend plays the role of [s]victim[/s] patient in this routine nightmare.

[From [url=https://specter-of-you.itch.io/hyponoia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尤尔是一只吸血蝙蝠，以其俏皮话和书法而闻名。他并不以手术技巧而闻名。他的朋友在这场例行噩梦中扮演[s]受害者[/s]患者的角色。

[来自[url=https://specter-of-you.itch.io/hyponoia]itch.io[/url]]
